steps.text:
The change behind it was commit **5ad0b3e**, written by **sam.r**.

- **Deployment:** dep-4815 (v1.9.3) of payments-worker (svc-payworker) went to production on 2026-10-23 at 16:40 UTC. Its status is `rolled_back`, and the previous commit was 3e1f2d0. sam.r also triggered the deployment.
- **The change:** commit 5ad0b3e in acme/payments-worker, PR #412, says "Lower ledger client timeout from 2s to 200ms". The only file it changes is `src/ledger/client.rs`, where the timeout goes from `Duration::from_secs(2)` to `Duration::from_millis(200)`.
- **Evidence it caused the rollback:** the deployment's error log at 16:44:02 UTC says "ledger-service call timed out after 200ms (retry budget exhausted)". That matches the new 200ms timeout.

One of my calls was rejected: my first commit lookup included an extra `repo` field, which isn't allowed. I retried without it and the lookup worked.
